_comment: Sign-in throttle vectors both gateways run with one client (go-web-proxy/throttle_test.go TestThrottle_SharedVectors, tests/mock-broker/gateway/throttle.test.ts). Each step does one thing: fail (a failed sign-in for that user, times times, default 1), succeed (a sign-in for that user), advance (seconds on the clock) or wait (the seconds a sign-in for that user must wait, want).

cases.name: another user's failures survive a success
the client blocks every name once it reaches the limit
each failure past the limit doubles the wait, up to the longest back-off
a block ends after its back-off
a count quiet for longer than the longest back-off starts again
names are counted by their first 64 bytes
